items.title: Perang LLM: Gemini vs GPT-4 Turbo vs Claude 3 - Siapa Unggul?
items.pt:
Lanskap LLM Terbaru: Gemini, GPT-4 Turbo, Claude 3


Dunia Model Bahasa Besar (LLM) berada dalam fase persaingan intens, didorong inovasi pesat raksasa teknologi. Google (Gemini), OpenAI (GPT-4 Turbo), dan Anthropic (Claude 3) berlomba menghadirkan kemampuan terdepan. Kompetisi ini melampaui ukuran model, berfokus pada jendela konteks, kemampuan multimodal, dan efisiensi biaya, mendorong batas AI generatif menuju aplikasi lebih kompleks dan canggih.

OpenAI memulai babak baru pada Oktober 2023 d

items.title: Beyond the Prompt: If AI Can Write the Code, What Are We Still Learning?
items.pt:

items.pt:

items.title: I started the project from a “sounds good” message (and the kickoff questions I ask now)
items.pt:
I once kicked off a project from a Slack message that just said “sounds good, let’s go.”

I opened the file the same afternoon. Two weeks later we were arguing about whose logo files I should have had on day one, whether “the homepage” included a blog index, and why the first invoice felt early. None of that was a difficult client. I had started without a shared picture of done.

The fix was not a longer contract. It was a short kickoff list I send before I bill the deposit or touch the file:

items.title: Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
items.pt: Long-context models use sparse or structured attention to avoid quadratic cost, yet retrieving a small set of relevant facts embedded among hundreds of thousands of distractors degrades as normalization mass disperses with length. Hub-and-spoke optimal transport (OT) replaces the dense $L \times L$ matrix with a linear-size graph over local windows and $K$ shared hubs balanced by Sinkhorn scaling. items.title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
items.pt: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. items.title: QuantStream3D: Geometry-Aligned Low-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers
items.pt: Streaming visual geometry transformers retain historical key-value (KV) states as cross-view geometric memory, but growing caches constrain long-sequence inference. We systematically characterize KV quantization in streaming geometry and uncover two linked challenges: Nonuniform Geometric Sensitivity and Cache-Geometry Mismatch.
